581e673cd4deadeabf9bda6cc155ec4a.overview: Billy Wilder’s Ace in the Hole is one of the most scathing indictments of American culture ever produced by a Hollywood filmmaker. Kirk Douglas gives the fiercest performance of his career as Chuck Tatum, an amoral newspaper reporter who washes up in dead-end Albuquerque, happens upon the scoop of a lifetime, and will do anything to keep getting the lurid headlines. Wilder’s follow-up to Sunset Boulevard is an even darker vision, a no-holds-barred exposé of the American media’s appetite for sensation that has gotten only more relevant with time.
581e673cd4deadeabf9bda6cc155ec4a.tagline: Rough, tough Chuck Tatum, who battered his way to the top... trampling everything in his path - men, women and morals !

582a59dec6ec0e7db72a8fc3a659b17c.overview: After two American prisoners are killed by guards in the act of escaping from a German POW camp in World War II, barracks black marketeer J.J. Sefton is suspected of being an informer.
582a59dec6ec0e7db72a8fc3a659b17c.tagline: The star-spangled, laugh-loaded salute to our P.W. heroes!

583113955fd2fac25426cb57d9e24890.overview: Years after her ship disappeared, a presumably dead woman returns home. To her shock, she finds her husband has remarried.
583113955fd2fac25426cb57d9e24890.tagline: The funniest, fastest honeymoon ever screened!

58451f75955674eab634b0f3c918343d.overview: Activist Bayard Rustin faces racism and homophobia as he helps change the course of Civil Rights history by orchestrating the 1963 March on Washington.

585790db8edf48c03b19bc132c63100c.overview: Home from college, Jeffrey Beaumont (Kyle MacLachlan) makes an unsettling discovery: a severed human ear, lying in a field. In the mystery that follows, by turns terrifying and darkly funny, writer-director David Lynch burrows deep beneath the picturesque surfaces of small-town life. Driven to investigate, Jeffrey finds himself drawing closer to his fellow amateur sleuth, Sandy Williams (Laura Dern), as well as their person of interest, lounge singer Dorothy Vallens (Isabella Rossellini)—and facing the fury of Frank Booth (Dennis Hopper), a psychopath who will stop at nothing to keep Dorothy in his grasp. With intense performances and hauntingly powerful scenes and images, Blue Velvet is an unforgettable vision of innocence lost, and one of the most influential American films of the late twentieth century.
585790db8edf48c03b19bc132c63100c.tagline: It's a strange world, isn't it?

58686c3af641715f1182f6c3dde7cf13.overview: Australian good girl Sandy and greaser Danny fell in love over the summer. But when they unexpectedly discover they're now in the same high school, will they be able to rekindle their romance despite their eccentric friends?

5885221f57f3a05ed38426ee012c3d8a.overview: The legendary Gilbert and Sullivan troupe the D’Oyly Carte Opera Company joined forces with Hollywood for this 1939 Technicolor version of the beloved comic opera The Mikado, the first work by the famed duo to be adapted for the screen. Directed by musician and Oscar-nominated filmmaker Victor Schertzinger, it is a lavish cinematic retelling of the British political satire set in exotic Japan, with such enduringly popular numbers as “A Wand’ring Minstrel I” and “Three Little Maids from School,” and featuring American singer Kenny Baker as well as a host of renowned D’Oyly Carte performers, including Martyn Green and Sydney Granville.

58913cd9a8c45555874860c767debc23.overview: "Patton" tells the tale of General George S. Patton, famous tank commander of World War II. The film begins with Patton's career in North Africa and progresses through the invasion of Germany and the fall of the Third Reich. Side plots also speak of Patton's numerous faults such his temper and habit towards insubordination.

58994a208be385f38d1344dc7c2963b9.overview: Three teenagers are confined to an isolated country estate that could very well be on another planet. The trio spend their days listening to endless homemade tapes that teach them a whole new vocabulary. Any word that comes from beyond their family abode is instantly assigned a new meaning. Hence 'the sea' refers to a large armchair and 'zombies' are little yellow flowers. Having invented a brother whom they claim to have ostracized for his disobedience, the uber-controlling parents terrorize their offspring into submission.
58994a208be385f38d1344dc7c2963b9.tagline: The nature of reality is entirely up to those who control it.

58a4ab4431f9783d72639159f6d9a8c0.overview: Samuel Fuller’s throat-grabbing exposé on American racism was misunderstood and withheld from release when it was made in the early eighties; today, the notorious film is lauded for its daring metaphor and gripping pulp filmmaking. Kristy McNichol stars as a young actress who adopts a lost German shepherd, only to discover through a series of horrifying incidents that the dog has been trained to attack black people, and Paul Winfield plays the animal trainer who tries to cure him. A snarling, uncompromising vision, White Dog is a tragic portrait of the evil done by that most corruptible of animals: the human being.
58a4ab4431f9783d72639159f6d9a8c0.tagline: When man’s best friend becomes his fiercest enemy…

58aed4fa3f7844ebb15a81c1d4b7c652.overview: In the summer of 1947, Britain prepares to commemorate the wedding of Princess Elizabeth and Prince Phillip. To get around food-rationing laws, Dr. Charles Swaby, accountant Henry Allardyce and solicitor Frank Lockwood are fattening a black-market pig for the big day. Egged on by his wife, meek Gilbert Chilvers steals the swine, but the couple must conceal it from inspector Morris Wormold.
58aed4fa3f7844ebb15a81c1d4b7c652.tagline: When a clandestine party goes wild, it's all about pork... and prestige.

58e07401770d3f9a9eb6d61946d6f78e.overview: While protecting an Amish boy—the sole witness to a brutal murder—and his mother, a detective is forced to seek refuge within their community when his own life comes under threat.
58e07401770d3f9a9eb6d61946d6f78e.tagline: A big city cop. A small country boy. They have nothing in common... but a murder.

58eb3044d7eb423760bb57cd3ccee7ea.overview: In Casablanca, Morocco in December 1941, a cynical American expatriate meets a former lover, with unforeseen complications.
